title: NdaTriage
description: One NDA triage: its screen, or its progress toward one.

id.title: Id
id.description: Public identifier, `ndt_` followed by 32 hex characters.

matterId.title: Matterid
matterId.description: `mat_` identifier of the matter this triage belongs to.

status.description: Triage status, using the same five public values as an operation. While `queued` or `running`, `criteria` is empty and the scalar fields are absent. That is the truthful shape of a screen that has not happened yet, not an error.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The screen's own verdict: `green` (standard approval), `yellow` (counsel review) or `red` (significant issues).

effectiveClassification.title: Effectiveclassification
effectiveClassification.description: The verdict after layering your playbook on top, which is the one to act on. A deal-breaker flips this to `red` even where the screen said `green`. Equal to `classification` when no playbook applied.

playbookId.title: Playbookid
playbookId.description: The playbook the triage actually ran against. Absent when it ran against the built-in defaults, so the two cases can be told apart after the fact.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the default positions were drawn from.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: The ten screening criteria and their results.

warnCount.title: Warncount
warnCount.description: How many criteria drew a warning.

keyIssues.title: Keyissues
keyIssues.description: The issues that need attention first.

routingRecommendation.title: Routingrecommendation
routingRecommendation.description: What to do next, given the classification.

estimatedTimeline.title: Estimatedtimeline
estimatedTimeline.description: How long resolution is expected to take, for example `Same day`.

missingCarveouts.title: Missingcarveouts
missingCarveouts.description: Standard carve-outs the NDA does not have. The one finding that cannot be expressed as a criterion result, because there is nothing there to assess.

problematicProvisions.title: Problematicprovisions
problematicProvisions.description: Provisions that do not belong in an NDA at all, for example a non-compete or an assignment of IP.

parseWarning.title: Parsewarning
parseWarning.description: Set when the model's output only partly parsed, which means the screen may be incomplete. Present is the difference between routing on it and asking a human first.

completedAt.title: Completedat
completedAt.description: When the triage reached a terminal status (RFC 3339).

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: How this criterion measures against the playbook: `meets_standard`, `within_acceptable_range`, `outside_range`, `deal_breaker_hit`, or `not_assessed` when the playbook has no entry for it.

playbookPosition.title: Playbookposition
playbookPosition.description: The standard position this criterion was measured against.

deviationSummary.title: Deviationsummary
deviationSummary.description: How this NDA differs from the standard, in one line. For example `Your standard: 5y term cap; this NDA: 10y`.

triggeredEscalations.title: Triggeredescalations
triggeredEscalations.description: Which of the playbook's escalation triggers fired on this criterion.

NdaPlaybookAssessment.title: NdaPlaybookAssessment
NdaPlaybookAssessment.description:
One criterion measured against the organization's own positions.

Computed deterministically from the playbook, not by the model: the LLM
knows what a market NDA looks like and only the playbook knows what this
firm will sign.

criterionId.title: Criterionid
criterionId.description: Stable number of this criterion, 1 through 10.

status.title: Status
status.description: The screen's verdict on this criterion: `pass`, `warn`, `fail`, or `not_found` when the NDA is silent.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: What the NDA actually says about this criterion.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: What to do about this criterion.

playbookAssessment.description: Verdict against your playbook. Absent when no playbook applied to this criterion.

NdaTriageCriterion.title: NdaTriageCriterion
NdaTriageCriterion.description: One of the ten screening criteria, and what the NDA said about it.

OperationStatus.title: OperationStatus
OperationStatus.description:
The public five. There is no sixth, and there are no synonyms.

Internal vocabularies spell terminal success `completed`, `ready`,
`extracted`, `succeeded` and `fresh`; terminal failure `failed` and `error`;
queued `pending`, `queued` and `draft`. All of that is collapsed here by
`app.workspace_api.adapters.status_map`, which refuses to guess.
